scope: Deny draft Save and Publish after an already-open tenant Editor loses editor membership, without discarding local work or changing stored/public content.

behavior.route: The Editor GET succeeds with editor membership. After the active membership is downgraded to viewer, both Save (publish=false) and Publish return 403; content_json, published_content_json, published_revision_id, is_published, editor revision count, and audit count remain unchanged.
behavior.browser: An exact SITE_ACCESS_DENIED 403 during Save leaves the unsaved field visible and dirty, leaves server draft and public content unchanged, and permits a later Save after access is restored without implicitly publishing.
behavior.save_publish: Save and Publish remain distinct operations.

runtime.deployment: No deployment for this test-only slice. Current Worker remains deployment 0add5fdb-fbdd-42a3-b2f7-8089e98c0ebe / version 9130eb09-666f-45b6-8bf3-5c324ac0b35b at 100% traffic.
runtime.production_d1_preflight: Not required for a test-only change; no production D1 query or mutation performed.

ci: No separate CI dispatch/rerun; test-only changes follow the repository [skip ci] policy.

limits.manual_physical_editor_acceptance: DEFERRED until the complete Editor scope
